title: 盛学CEO罗斯曼：中企转向新市场，得州设厂遇阻
speaker: Andy Rothman

segments.en: Yeah, one of the more interesting trends in recent years has been how private Chinese companies have shifted markets
segments.zh: 是的，近年来一个比较有趣的趋势是，中国私营企业如何转移市场

segments.en: To places where they're more welcome. So if you go back to
segments.zh: 转向更受欢迎的地方。所以如果你回到

segments.en: 25 years ago when China joined the WTO almost half of their exports went to the g7 now that's down to one quarter
segments.zh: 25年前中国加入WTO时，近一半出口流向七国集团，现在下降到四分之一。

segments.en: And this is private company saying well if you don't want us in your market will find another market
segments.zh: 这是私营企业在说，好吧，如果你不想让我们进入你的市场，我们会找到另一个市场。

segments.en: There's so many barriers. I was in Guangdong
segments.zh: 有太多壁垒。我当时在广东

segments.en: A couple of weeks ago talking to a company that's making sophisticated liquid cooling systems for data centers
segments.zh: 几周前与一家为数据中心制造精密液冷系统的公司交谈。

segments.en: They're exporting a bit to the US
But they wanted to set up a factory there. They landed on Texas. It's a great location
segments.zh: 但他们想在那里建厂。他们选择了得克萨斯州。那是个好位置。

segments.en: But now Texas has a law prohibiting Chinese companies from long-term leasing land to build a factory
segments.zh: 但现在得克萨斯州有一项法律，禁止中国公司长期租赁土地建厂。
